auth_challenge_live_phone_key.name: auth_challenge_live_phone_key
auth_challenge_live_phone_key.where: "auth_challenge"."consumed_at" is null and "auth_challenge"."phone" is not null

check_in_answer_one_value.name: check_in_answer_one_value
check_in_answer_one_value.value:
("check_in_answer"."number_value" is not null)::int + ("check_in_answer"."text_value" is not null)::int
          + ("check_in_answer"."rating_value" is not null)::int + ("check_in_answer"."image_url" is not null)::int = 1

client_studio_user_key.name: client_studio_user_key
client_studio_user_key.where: "client"."user_id" is not null and "client"."deleted_at" is null

waitlist_has_a_contact.name: waitlist_has_a_contact
waitlist_has_a_contact.value: "waitlist"."email" is not null or "waitlist"."phone" is not null

food_log_entry_one_source.name: food_log_entry_one_source
food_log_entry_one_source.value:
("food_log_entry"."recipe_id" is not null)::int + ("food_log_entry"."ingredient_id" is not null)::int +
          ("food_log_entry"."manual_name" is not null)::int = 1

ingredient_system_name_key.name: ingredient_system_name_key
ingredient_system_name_key.where: "ingredient"."studio_id" is null and "ingredient"."client_id" is null and "ingredient"."barcode" is null and "ingredient"."deleted_at" is null

ingredient_barcode_key.name: ingredient_barcode_key
ingredient_barcode_key.where: "ingredient"."barcode" is not null and "ingredient"."client_id" is null

ingredient_client_barcode_key.name: ingredient_client_barcode_key
ingredient_client_barcode_key.where: "ingredient"."barcode" is not null and "ingredient"."client_id" is not null and "ingredient"."deleted_at" is null

meal_plan_preset_split_sane.name: meal_plan_preset_split_sane
meal_plan_preset_split_sane.value: "meal_plan_preset"."protein_pct" between 0 and 100 and "meal_plan_preset"."carbs_pct" between 0 and 100 and "meal_plan_preset"."fat_pct" between 0 and 100 and abs("meal_plan_preset"."protein_pct"+"meal_plan_preset"."carbs_pct"+"meal_plan_preset"."fat_pct"-100)<0.02

meal_plan_template_macro_pct_sane.name: meal_plan_template_macro_pct_sane
meal_plan_template_macro_pct_sane.value: "meal_plan_template"."protein_pct" between 0 and 100 and "meal_plan_template"."carbs_pct" between 0 and 100 and "meal_plan_template"."fat_pct" between 0 and 100 and abs("meal_plan_template"."protein_pct" + "meal_plan_template"."carbs_pct" + "meal_plan_template"."fat_pct" - 100) < 0.02

recipe_owner_sane.name: recipe_owner_sane
recipe_owner_sane.value: ("recipe"."source"::text = 'system' and "recipe"."studio_id" is null and "recipe"."client_id" is null) or ("recipe"."source"::text <> 'system' and "recipe"."studio_id" is not null)

user_email_or_phone.name: user_email_or_phone
user_email_or_phone.value: "user"."email" is not null or "user"."phone" is not null

exercise_set_rep_range_sane.name: exercise_set_rep_range_sane
exercise_set_rep_range_sane.value: "exercise_set"."reps_max" is null or "exercise_set"."reps" is null or "exercise_set"."reps_max" >= "exercise_set"."reps"
